FAQ.title: 💻 IT Equipment Request
FAQ.description:
📌 Purpose

This process outlines the steps for requesting IT equipment (e.g., laptops, monitors, peripherals, software licenses) within our organization. All requests must be submitted via the approved channels to ensure proper tracking, approval, and fulfillment.

👥 Scope

Applies to all employees, contractors, and departments requiring IT equipment for work purposes.

✅ Step 1: Determine Your Need

Before submitting a request:

  • Confirm the equipment is necessary for your role or project.
  • Check if the item is available in the IT inventory (e.g., loaner laptops, shared devices).
  • Verify if the request aligns with  IT policies (e.g., approved brands, specifications).

📝 Step 2: Submit a Request

Method 1: Online Form (Recommended)

  1. Access the IT Request Portal ([insert link]).
  2. Fill out the Equipment Request Form with the following details:
    • Requester Name & Department
    • Equipment Type (e.g., laptop, monitor, keyboard)
    • Model/Specifications (if known)
    • Quantity
    • Business Justification (e.g., project name, replacement for broken device)
    • Preferred Delivery Date
    • Cost Center/Budget Code (if applicable)

Method 2: Email Send an email to it-requests@[yourorganization].com with the subject line: “IT Equipment Request – [Your Name] – [Equipment Type]” Include all details from the online form in the email body.

🔍 Step 3: Approval Workflow

  1. Manager Approval:
    • Your direct manager will review the request for business justification and budget alignment.
    • Approval/rejection notification sent within 2 business days.
  2. IT Team Review:
    • IT verifies compatibility, availability, and compliance with security standards.
    • For high-cost items (> $[X]), Finance approval may be required.
  3. Procurement (if applicable):
    • If the item is not in stock, IT will initiate a purchase order.
    • Lead time: 5–10 business days (varies by vendor).

📦 Step 4: Fulfillment

  • In-Stock Items: Delivered to your desk/office within 3 business days of approval.
  • Custom Orders: Timeline communicated by IT after procurement.
  • Setup Support: IT will configure devices (e.g., install OS, software, connect to network) if required.

📊 Step 5: Post-Delivery Actions

  1. Acknowledgment:
    • Confirm receipt of the equipment via the IT Portal or email.
  2. Inventory Tagging:
    • IT will assign an asset tag to the equipment for tracking.
  3. User Responsibility:
    • Equipment is the user’s responsibility until return or replacement.
    • Report any issues to it-support@[yourorganization].com.

🔄 Step 6: Returns & Replacements

  • Defective Equipment: Report to IT within 7 days of receipt for replacement.
  • End of Use: Return equipment to IT when:
    • No longer needed.
    • Leaving the organization.
    • Upgrading to new equipment.
  • Process: Submit a Return Request via the IT Portal.

📅 Timeline Summary

💡 Tips for Faster Processing

  • Provide complete details in your request to avoid delays.
  • Check IT inventory first for available loaner devices.
  • Plan ahead for custom orders (e.g., high-spec laptops).

📞 Support Contacts

  • IT Request Portal: [Insert Link]
  • IT Support Email: it-support@[yourorganization].com
  • IT Helpdesk Phone: +5691583235464
  • Urgent Issues: Contact the IT Helpdesk directly.

📜 Policy Reminders

  • All equipment remains the property of organization.
  • Unauthorized modifications (e.g., hardware/software changes) are prohibited.
  • Lost or damaged equipment may result in replacement costs charged to the user/department.

FAQ.title: 📌 Leave Management
FAQ.description:
❓ How can I request leave?

Answer: You can request leave in two ways:

  • 💻 Online: Via the internal HR portal (under the "My Leave" tab).
  • 📧 By email: Send a request to your manager and the HR team (rh@entreprise.com), specifying:
    • Your full name.
    • The start and end dates of your leave.
    • The type of leave (e.g., paid leave, RTT, sick leave, etc.).

⏳ What is the deadline for requesting leave?

Answer:

  • Paid leave: At least 15 days before the start date (unless it's an emergency, which must be validated with your manager).
  • Exceptional leave (e.g., wedding, birth): Notify as soon as possible, ideally 48 hours in advance.
  • Sick leave/Accident: Inform your manager and HR on the same day.

📅 How many paid leave days am I entitled to?

Answer: In France, you earn 2.5 working days of paid leave per month worked (equivalent to 30 working days per year for full-time employees). Your balance is visible in your personal space.

Special cases:

  • Part-time: Leave is calculated pro rata.
  • New employee: Leave is earned after 1 month of effective work.

🔄 Can I cancel or modify my leave?

Answer: Yes, but under certain conditions:

  • Modification: Notify your manager and HR at least 7 days before the start date.
  • Cancellation: Possible in case of an emergency (e.g., illness) with supporting documents (e.g., medical certificate). ⚠️ Note: Validated leave cannot be canceled without your manager's approval.

❌ What should I do if my leave request is denied?

Answer: If your request is denied (e.g., due to high workload), you can:

  • Propose alternative dates.
  • Contact HR to find a solution (e.g., spreading out your leave).

Possible reasons for denial:

  • Too many simultaneous requests in your team.
  • Critical period for the company (e.g., inventory, year-end closing).

📆 How are leave days calculated for mid-week departures?

Answer: Paid leave is counted in working days (Monday to Saturday, excluding Sundays and public holidays). Example: If you take leave from Wednesday to Friday, it counts as 3 working days.

🎉 Can I take leave during public holidays?

Answer: Yes, but public holidays are not deducted from your paid leave. They are considered non-working days. Example: If you take leave from Monday to Friday and Tuesday is a public holiday, only 4 days will be deducted.

🚨 What should I do in case of an emergency (illness, accident) during my leave?

Answer:

  • Sick leave/Accident: Send a medical certificate to rh@entreprise.com to suspend your paid leave.
  • Bereavement: Contact HR immediately for exceptional leave.

📊 Where can I check my leave balance?

Answer: Your balance is available:

  • On the HR portal.
  • In your payslip (under "Accrued Paid Leave").
  • Via a monthly reminder email (if enabled by your company).

🆘 Who should I contact if I have issues with my leave request?

Answer:

  • Technical issues (HR portal): support-it@entreprise.com
  • Questions about your rights: rh@entreprise.com
  • Emergency: Your direct manager.

FAQ.title: 🖨️🔄 Printer firmware update
FAQ.description:
📌 Preparation

🛠️ Required Equipment

  • 💻 A computer connected to the same network as the printer (or a USB cable if needed).
  • 📁 The official firmware file (downloaded from the manufacturer's website).
  • 🌐 A stable internet connection (for downloading).
  • 🔑 An administrator account on the computer (if required).

⚠️ Precautions

  • ❌ Do not turn off the printer during the update.
  • ✅ Ensure the printer is plugged into a power outlet (not in sleep mode).
  • 💾 Backup the printer settings (if possible).

🔍 Identify the Model and Current Version

  • Find the exact model: Check the label on the back or bottom of the printer.
  • Check the current firmware version:
    • Print a configuration page (via the printer menu or manufacturer software).
    • Note the current version (e.g., "Firmware: V1.02").

📥 Download the Firmware

  • 🌍 Visit the manufacturer’s official website (e.g., support.hp.com, canon.fr, etc.).
  • 🔍 Enter your printer’s exact model.
  • 📥 Download the latest firmware version (file types: .exe, .bin, or .dmg).
  • ✅ Verify compatibility: The firmware must match your printer model and region.

🔄 Update Methods

Method 1: Via Manufacturer Software (Recommended)

  • 📥 Install the printer management software (e.g., HP Smart, Epson Software Updater).
  • 🔌 Connect the printer to the computer (Wi-Fi, Ethernet, or USB).
  • 🔄 Launch the software and check for updates:
    • Go to Settings > Firmware Update.
    • Follow the on-screen instructions.
  • ⏳ Do not interrupt the update (duration: 5 to 15 minutes).

Method 2: Via Printer Control Panel

  • 🖥️ Access the printer menu (touchscreen or buttons).
  • ⚙️ Go to Settings > Maintenance > Firmware Update.
  • 🔄 Select Update via USB or Network.
  • 📂 Follow the instructions to select the downloaded file.

Method 3: Via Executable File (USB)

  • 💾 Copy the firmware file to a FAT32-formatted USB drive.
  • ⚡ Turn off the printer.
  • 🔌 Insert the USB drive into the printer’s port.
  • ⚡ Turn on the printer while holding the power button (if required by the model).
  • 🖨️ The printer will detect the file and start the update automatically.

✅ Post-Update Verification

  • 🔄 Restart the printer.
  • 🖨️ Print a test page or configuration page to verify the new firmware version.
  • 🧪 Test the printer functions (printing, scanning, network connection).

🚨 Troubleshooting

Update Failure

  • 🔌 Check the connection (USB/network).
  • 🔄 Restart the printer and try again.
  • 📞 Contact the manufacturer’s support if the issue persists.

Printer Frozen

  • ⚡ Turn off and on the printer.
  • 🔄 If the issue persists, perform a factory reset (refer to the manual).

📚 Documentation and Support

  • 💾 Keep a copy of the installed firmware (just in case).
  • 📝 Note the new version in your CMDB.
  • ❓ If in doubt, consult the user manual or the manufacturer’s technical support.
